name: Akari Kutsuki
source:
Akari, to most, is a very warm, loving and excitable girl who always tries to find the best in people, who thrives on individuality and loves seeing how people make themselves stand out. While her teasing and jokes can get a little overbearing and sometimes hit too close to home, she tries her best. She’s not the smartest, but she really pushes herself and gets extremely stressed when she only gets a slightly low score on a test, holding education a little too highly. Meanwhile, she gets distracted when she’s meant to be studying by hanging out with friends.

Around Ultimates, however, she’s extremely harsh, foul mouthed and incredibly vulgar. She will not hesitate to insult an ultimate and often acts apathetic and blunt around them, but is a lot less tolerant of their bullshit and will often tell them that she didn’t ask when they start rambling about their talent. She is very quick to point out their mistakes and is sort of judgemental, acting stubborn and sometimes even threatening to get aggressive if they annoy her too much. However, she quickly gets flustered and stressed when asked about her own abilities, becoming defensive at any sense of apprehension.

[From [url=https://aminoapps.com/c/danganronpa/page/blog/just-a-lass/o3J8_eXDSdu7KKXvjdEoBnMML2d0kqYDLJb] the main developer's Amino page[/url]]
